## Purpose and entry points
OfficeCLI is a self-contained, cross-platform .NET CLI for creating, reading, modifying, validating, rendering, and batch-processing OOXML Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without Office. Main process entry is `src/officecli/Program.cs`; command registration/parsing is centralized in `src/officecli/CommandBuilder.cs`. Distribution wrappers include `install.sh`, `install.ps1`, and the npm launcher `npm/officecli.js`.

## Command and document dispatch
The command layer maps create/view/get/query/mutation, raw XML, batch, merge, watch, install, plugins, resident, and MCP commands to shared operations and format handlers. `src/officecli/CommandBuilder.Batch.cs` defines batch command wiring; `src/officecli/Handlers/DocumentHandlerFactory.cs` selects the handler from file type; `src/officecli/Core/IDocumentHandler.cs` is the principal format boundary.

## Format-specific OOXML manipulation
Three large handler families implement the semantic DOM and OOXML mutations:
- Word: `src/officecli/Handlers/WordHandler.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Word/WordHandler.Set.Dispatch.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Word/WordBatchEmitter.cs`
- Excel: `src/officecli/Handlers/ExcelHandler.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Excel/ExcelHandler.Set.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Excel/ExcelBatchEmitter.cs`
- PowerPoint: `src/officecli/Handlers/PowerPointHandler.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Pptx/PowerPointHandler.Mutations.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Pptx/PptxBatchEmitter.cs`

Handlers expose stable path/selector-based elements, while batch emitters serialize document structure into replayable operations. Raw XML commands remain an explicit escape hatch via `src/officecli/Core/RawXmlHelper.cs`.

## Shared document engines
Core services own cross-format capabilities: atomic package persistence (`src/officecli/Core/AtomicPackageWriter.cs`), template placeholder replacement (`src/officecli/Core/TemplateMerger.cs`), native chart construction/rendering (`src/officecli/Core/Chart/ChartHelper.cs`), Mermaid parsing/layout into editable diagrams (`src/officecli/Core/Diagram/DiagramCompiler.cs`), and Excel formula evaluation (`src/officecli/Core/Formula/FormulaEvaluator.cs`). These services are invoked by handlers rather than exposed as independent applications.

## Rendering, preview, and quality loop
Handlers generate render inputs for a common renderer registry, producing HTML/SVG/screenshots and document issue views. Key boundary paths are `src/officecli/Core/Rendering/RendererRegistry.cs`, `src/officecli/Handlers/Rendering/BasicRenderers.cs`, and format-specific preview emitters such as `src/officecli/Handlers/Pptx/PowerPointHandler.HtmlPreview.cs`. PNG screenshot generation uses a headless-browser path (`src/officecli/Core/HtmlScreenshot.cs`). `watch` serves a local auto-refresh preview through `src/officecli/Core/Watch/WatchServer.cs`.

## Stateful and agent-facing integration
Resident mode keeps documents in memory across CLI calls over local IPC, deferring or controlling disk flushes: `src/officecli/ResidentServer.cs`, `src/officecli/ResidentClient.cs`, `src/officecli/Core/ResidentFlushPolicy.cs`. The MCP server exposes document operations over JSON-RPC for agent clients (`src/officecli/McpServer.cs`, `src/officecli/McpInstaller.cs`). Thin Node and Python SDKs use this resident protocol: `sdk/node/index.js` and `sdk/python/officecli.py`.

## Extensibility, contracts, and delivery
Plugin processes provide format handlers, exporters, and dump readers behind an isolated protocol: `src/officecli/Core/Plugins/PluginRegistry.cs`, `src/officecli/Core/Plugins/PluginProcess.cs`, `plugins/plugin-protocol.md`. JSON help schemas define the supported semantic command surface and are loaded at runtime from `schemas/help/` through `src/officecli/Help/SchemaHelpLoader.cs`. Builds require .NET 10 but publish self-contained native binaries via `build.sh`; release packaging targets npm, PyPI, and SDK channels through `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml`, `.github/workflows/publish-pypi.yml`, and `.github/workflows/publish-sdk.yml`.
